criteria.note: Both new endpoints (main.py upgrade_preview, upgrade) apply the same email-existence check as every pre-existing endpoint (billing, tasks, add_task) before any read/write; no endpoint is less strict than the existing pattern.

days_remaining is floored at max(1, ...); the already-Premium guard runs before charge_card on both endpoints so a second call after success returns 409, never a second charge; verified by test_already_premium_guard_on_preview_and_upgrade.

All three documented error paths (401/402/409) return the exact documented {detail, message?} shape with no internal detail leaked; renew_at is only ever written by this same backend (never user input), so the strptime call has no externally reachable exception path this diff introduces.

New backend deps (pytest, pytest-cov, httpx, pytest-bdd) are unpinned, matching the existing requirements.txt convention (fastapi, uvicorn[standard] are also unpinned) — not a new deviation. No payment/network SDK was added.
